figurative_meaning_en: The union of favorable factors ensuring the success of an endeavor
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পে সকল অনুকূলতা অষ্টবজ্রসম্মেলনের মতো একত্রিত হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The union of all favorable conditions, like an ashtavajra sammelan, led to the business success.
All the stars aligned in an ashtavajra sammelan for the project's triumph.
history: Derived from Hindu mythological concepts involving Indra's vajra (thunderbolt), symbolizing powerful forces uniting.
note: The idiom draws from Sanskrit roots, emphasizing cosmic or divine alignment for success.
